title: Next lesson now unlocks immediately, not the following day
changes: ensureDailyJourneyRoute() used to only regenerate the daily route when the calendar date changed, so even after a lesson was fully completed the next one wouldn't appear until the next day. That was never the intended design: only per-word mastery review is meant to be paced day-to-day (via normal spaced-repetition scheduling). Lesson unlock now happens the moment the current lesson is complete, same day, by also regenerating whenever the underlying current chapter has advanced — not just on a date change.

This also resolves the last inconsistency from v11.25.5: journey.js's timeline and the app's own daily-mission route now agree on which lesson is current, in every case, not just the day-rollover case.
